reproduces: R3 missing-emit (runs/2026-09-12-q42-review/results.json): the baseline navmesh emit was deleted and finalize exited 0, the check stayed a completed null check, bundle exited 0 and verify-bundle reported complete: true with 64 files verified
note: The scenario emits ZERO conflict rows with judged > 0 on every geometry probe, so the checks are COMPLETED NULL CHECKS and the disposition's completedNullChecks list is the thing the deleted evidence must fall out of.

finalize.damage: delete sweep/navownprobe/baseline.json (an accepted receipt's recorded output), exactly as reproduce.py does

expect.rulingApplied: A-8: A-5 as written over-specified this. An entry whose OWN recorded output or run-internal input is the lost or changed file is evidence-missing(<path>) / evidence-changed(<path>) even when it is also a dependent - the candidate arm receipt records the baseline emit as its base emit (D4), so losing that emit is a DIRECT loss for it. evidence-dependency(<key>) is for entries whose own outputs and inputs are intact: the reverse and diff parts.
expect.rule: D6: every outputs[] file must exist and hash to the receipt's recorded sha256; an entry that fails is NOT completed, is listed under evaluation.missing with status evidence-missing(<path>), its detector is not counted under findings / completedNullChecks / completedCatalogues, and the disposition carries evaluation.integrity {ok, defects}. When any integrity defect exists finalize writes the full disposition and STATUS.md, sets evaluation.refused `evidence-integrity`, and exits 3.

thenBundle.rule: D7: bundle refuses (exit 3, by name) when any accepted receipt's output file is missing or hashes differently from the receipt's recorded value (evidence-missing / evidence-changed, naming receipt and path), and when the disposition records a refusal (disposition-refused). A bundle that cannot be assembled cannot then be verified as complete.

finalize.damage: append bytes to sweep/navownprobe/baseline.json so it exists but no longer hashes to the receipt's recorded sha256

expect.rulingApplied: A-8: A-5 as written over-specified this. An entry whose OWN recorded output or run-internal input is the lost or changed file is evidence-missing(<path>) / evidence-changed(<path>) even when it is also a dependent - the candidate arm receipt records the baseline emit as its base emit (D4), so losing that emit is a DIRECT loss for it. evidence-dependency(<key>) is for entries whose own outputs and inputs are intact: the reverse and diff parts.
expect.rule: D6: evidence-changed(<path>), with the recorded and found hashes in the defect row

verifyBundle.why: D8's named defects, in order, each on its own copy of a HEALTHY bundle so one damage is one answer

cases.damage: delete STATUS.md from the bundle copy — a control file verify-bundle reads for nothing else, so the ONLY thing that can bite is the required-set check
cases.rule: D8 step (2) alone: every `required` path present. (V's arm 13 note: deleting disposition.json also trips step (6), so this case isolates the required-set check.)

cases.damage: delete disposition.json from the bundle copy
cases.rule: D8 step (2): every `required` path present. D7 fixes the six control files (plan.json, plan.sha256, ledger.json, journal.jsonl, disposition.json, STATUS.md) as manifest.required.

cases.damage: remove one accepted receipt output's row from manifest.json's evidence list; the file itself stays on disk
cases.rule: D8 step (5): each output present under evidence/ with the receipt's recorded hash AND listed in the manifest (manifest-omits-required otherwise). This is the R3 hole at the verify layer: verify-bundle checked only the files the manifest chose to list.

cases.damage: append bytes to one evidence file that the manifest lists
cases.rule: D8 step (2): every evidence row present and hashing to its recorded sha256

cases.damage: set bundleSchema to 1 in the manifest of a bundle copy
cases.rule: A-1: verify-bundle on a bundleSchema 1 manifest is schema-unsupported: `this bundle predates evidence-chain verification; rebuild it from its run`. D8 step (1): bundleSchema supported, else schema-unsupported, explicit.

runControlMissing.damage: after a healthy finalize, delete STATUS.md from the RUN directory, then bundle
runControlMissing.rule: A-9 (V's finding 1): a control file missing from the run is a bundle refusal by name, never a path that drops out of manifest.required because nothing was copied under it. Measured on the first build: STATUS.md deleted, bundle exit 0, 20 required paths without it, verify complete: true.

q42DemoBundle.whyCopied: verify-bundle WRITES verify.json into the directory it verifies, so the original Q42 artifact is never verified in place
q42DemoBundle.rule: A-1: Q42's demo bundle is the integration input for the schema refusal — a bundleSchema 1 bundle is refused by name, never silently certified
q42DemoBundle.unavailableNote: the demo run is untracked and lives only in the main checkout. When the path is absent the case prints a NOTE and the same rule stays covered by verifyBundle.cases[schema-unsupported], which builds a bundleSchema 1 manifest from this run's own healthy bundle.
